name: Route planner
summary: Plans the daily routes of a **fictional** freight company's trucks.
problem: Dispatchers planned every route by hand from a shared spreadsheet.
workDone: Built a planner service over PostgreSQL with a small review screen for dispatchers.
result: The team plans a whole day of routes in minutes instead of a morning.

caseStudy.body:
## Context

A **fictional** dispatch team with one spreadsheet.

## Approach

We replayed a month of old routes against every planner change before it shipped.

## Outcome

The replay suite now guards every change to the planner.

name: Clinic scheduling
summary: Books appointments across the clinics of a **fictional** health network.
problem: Patients waited on the phone to book and clinics double-booked rooms.
workDone: Rebuilt the booking flow in React over one PostgreSQL schedule.
result: Online bookings replaced most phone calls and double bookings stopped.

caseStudy.role: Senior developer responsible for the booking flow
caseStudy.body:
## Context

Three **fictional** clinics shared one calendar.

## Approach

We moved one clinic at a time and kept the old calendar readable until the last one moved.

## Outcome

Every clinic books online.

name: Records export
summary: Exports a patient's **fictional** records on request.
problem: Exports were assembled by hand and took a week.
workDone: Wrote an export job that collects the records into one archive.
result: An export is ready the same day.

name: Ledger importer
summary: Imports bank statements into a **fictional** open-source ledger.
problem: Every bank's statement format needed its own script.
workDone: Designed one importer with a small adapter per format.
result: Contributors add a bank format in an afternoon.
